title: Search pills select, delete and come back with Undo
steps: Press /, type from:dana has:attachment and a space, so both become pills; press Backspace twice, then Command-Z
Press Left Arrow twice, then Right Arrow twice, then Forward Delete after selecting a pill
Hover a pill and click its x; click another pill and press Backspace; type a word, press Command-A, then Backspace
Type from:dana and a space, press Backspace once, then Escape
expected: Backspace highlights the pill before the caret, then removes it; Command-Z restores it. Arrows walk across the pills and Forward Delete removes the highlighted one. Hovering shows an x that removes a pill; a clicked pill goes on Backspace. Command-A, Backspace clears all. Escape lets go of a highlighted pill and keeps it.
